_comment: UNIRA V6.3 avoidable-output accounting. All results in hours. Candidate selection is NORMATIVE (democratic choice); the model only measures hours.

market_specific_candidates._evidence_class: NORMATIVE_TARGET (candidates flagged by UNIRA principles, not evidence that they are avoidable)

CPA_M73.label: Advertising and market research
CPA_M73.principle: Article 11: no production merely to sustain sales; public information still needed

CPA_L68B.label: Real estate services (excl. imputed rent)
CPA_L68B.principle: No land speculation; housing allocation and management still needed

CPA_K64.label: Financial services except insurance
CPA_K64.principle: Public U payment system (UGTN); credit and payments still needed

CPA_K66.label: Services auxiliary to finance (brokerage, fund management)

CPA_K65.label: Insurance and pension funding
CPA_K65.principle: Universal guarantees replace part of private insurance; risk pooling still needed

CPA_M69_70.label: Legal, accounting, head offices, management consulting
CPA_M69_70.principle: Simpler tax/benefit rules, less litigation over property; core legal/accounting needed

excluded.CPA_N78: Labour pass-through: temp-agency workers are recorded in N78 but work in client industries; removing agencies does not remove their work. Hypothetical extraction of N78 is therefore not a valid saving.

durables._comment: Article 11 stock-first: longer product lifetimes reduce replacement purchases; repair hours rise. Lifetime extension is a SYNTHETIC sensitivity.

repair_hours_per_saved_hour.note: each hour of avoided new production needs 0.25 h of extra repair/maintenance; placeholder pending evidence
